name: Roshan Kettlewell-Amadou
role: Protection racket enforcer for the Grainfort Tithe
location: Grainfort, operates the southwest market corridor and adjacent residential blocks, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Roshan is physically extraordinary—193 centimeters and built like a structural beam, with warm medium-brown skin, a shaved head he keeps obsessively smooth, and a jaw that looks like it was designed by committee to be intimidating. His geneware gives him a very slight bioluminescent flush along his cheekbones and temples in blue-white—barely visible in daylight, unmistakable at night, which was exactly the aesthetic point. He has the slightly careful way of moving that very large people develop when they've broken something by accident more than once.

What catches people off guard is that Roshan is polite almost to a fault, speaks in a quiet voice he never raises, and seems genuinely distressed when he has to hurt someone. He is not performing gentleness—he really does not enjoy violence, which makes him more unsettling than someone who obviously does. He has been with the Tithe since he was seventeen and has never questioned whether this is where he should be, mostly because thinking about alternatives feels like standing at the edge of something with no floor. He goes home after his rounds to a small flat he shares with his younger sister, feeds an illegal cat, and watches old sports footage before sleeping.

core_fears: His sister discovering exactly what he does and how he does it
That he is not actually a good person, just a person who prefers not to hurt people when he can avoid it
core_desires: His sister to be safe and stable in a way he never was
To be respected for something other than his size
coping_mechanisms: Rigid routine and physical cleanliness as order-maintenance
The cat—caring for something small and dependent
blind_spots: He does not register how his presence alone constitutes coercion even when he's being pleasant
He has convinced himself the Tithe is fundamentally protective rather than extractive
psychology.secret: Two years ago, during a debt enforcement visit, he went further than he intended with a market stall operator—a middle-aged woman who couldn't pay. She is fine now, recovered, still running her stall. But she flinches every time she sees him coming and he knows it and he pays her tithe from his own cut every month anonymously through a delivery bot, which does not in any way fix what he did but is the only repair he can think of.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Simple and direct, avoids long sentences. Occasionally formal in a way that suggests he picked up speech patterns from older Tithe members and internalized them.
speech_patterns.cadence: Quiet, even, unhurried. The low volume forces people to pay attention.
verbal_tics: 'That's not something I want to happen.'
Refers to the Tithe as 'the arrangement' when talking to merchants
example_lines: 'Everybody's week gets better when the arrangement goes smooth. I really do mean that. You want some water? You look tired.'
'I'm going to come back Thursday. I'd like Thursday to be a nothing visit. I think you'd like that too.'

story_hooks: A new merchant in the corridor—young, Tier 1, clearly terrified—has asked Roshan quietly whether there's any way to get exempt from the Tithe, and Roshan is processing a feeling he doesn't have words for

Someone has been leaving threatening messages for the stall operator Roshan injured, and it has nothing to do with the Tithe—and Roshan has discovered he will apparently do something about it without being asked or paid
narrative_function: Human face of street-level protection racket, potential reluctant ally or sympathetic obstacle, illustrates the social ecosystem of Grainfort—who pays, who complains, who has been paying for years without incident.
augmentations: Bioluminescent cheekbone and temple flush (blue-white, geneware, cosmetic). Bone-lacing in forearms—stress-distribution modification, legal gray area, installed by a Tithe-connected medic. Subdermal impact dampener plates across knuckles.
daily_life: Makes rounds of the southwest market corridor every morning, collecting weekly tithe envelopes from thirty-seven establishments; afternoons on call for enforcement responses; evenings mostly free unless escalated.
affiliation: The Grainfort Tithe (local protection and territory collective, Tier 1-2 criminal organization)

decision_rules: Always give the merchant a face-saving way to comply before applying pressure
Never threaten family members—that is the line he will not cross regardless of instruction
escalation_ladder: Follow-up visit, explicitly gentle—expresses disappointment more than threat
Arrives with a Tithe colleague, still polite, much more clearly structural
Physical demonstration of consequence, minimal and targeted, visibly unhappy about it

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Quietly courteous, lets his size do the ambient work so he doesn't have to be rude
interpersonal_modes.friends: Unguarded, occasionally funny in a dry deadpan way, loyal to a degree that could become a problem

stress_responses.low: Cleans the flat, grooms the cat
stress_responses.medium: Goes to the Tithe's gym space and lifts until exhausted
stress_responses.high: Becomes very quiet and still, which people who know him understand as a danger sign

contradictions: Genuinely dislikes violence but has structured his entire working life around the implicit threat of it
Pays the market woman's tithe as atonement while continuing to enforce on everyone else
habits: Checks his route in the same order every day, never varies
Buys tea from the same stall at the end of his morning rounds regardless of whether he wants it—it's a tip in disguise
breaking_points: Being ordered to harm the market woman again, or anyone who reminds him of her

timeline.event: Age 15: Mother died of untreated pulmonary failure, became sole support for younger sister
Age 17: Recruited by the Grainfort Tithe—initially as a courier, moved to enforcement within four months
Age 20: The incident with the market stall operator
Age 20-present: Paying her tithe anonymously from his own cut

physical_description.build: Exceptionally large and structurally dense—shoulders like load-bearing columns, forearms visibly reinforced beneath the skin with bone-lacing modifications. Not bulky from bodybuilding; rather, engineered mass optimized for impact absorption and structural integrity. Moves with deliberate, economical precision despite his size.
physical_description.hair_style: Shaved to bare scalp, kept obsessively smooth—no stubble, no texture. Ritual grooming suggests control and self-maintenance.
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with South Asian and West African undertones; even complexion without blemish
physical_description.complexion: Strong jawline with squared edges and prominent mandible—architecture that reads as intimidating. Clean-shaven. Unmarred face; the kind of careful symmetry that suggests his geneware and augmentations were installed with precision by medical professionals, not street techs. Slight blue-white bioluminescent flush visible along cheekbones and temples—most apparent in low light, creates an eerie subliminal glow.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware traces along cheekbones and temples: blue-white glow, cosmetic modification installed for aesthetic/intimidation value, most visible in evening/night conditions.
Faint linear scarring along inside of left forearm where bone-lacing installation incisions healed—barely visible unless limb is at specific angle to light, approximately 12 centimeters long.
Subdermal impact dampener plates visible as subtle geometric ridges across knuckles when fists are clenched—slight metallic sheen under skin, approximately 2-3 millimeters relief.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Bioluminescent cheekbone/temple flush (blue-white, cosmetic geneware—unmistakable at night, subtle in daylight). Slight geometric relief pattern visible across knuckles suggesting subdermal plating. Forearm bone-lacing creates subtle density variation visible under skin in certain lighting, though not obvious without close inspection.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands at full height with shoulders relaxed, not squared aggressively. Moves with unusual grace for someone 193cm tall—economical, controlled, deliberate. Each motion appears calculated to minimize accidental damage. When reaching for something, he slows down. When walking through crowded spaces, he becomes hyperaware of his spatial footprint. Body language reads as quiet and contained rather than threatening, which creates cognitive dissonance with his physical presence.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 1-2 enforcer uniform: well-fitted black or charcoal synthetic-blend long-sleeve shirts (breathable, durable) worn untucked. Matte-finish tactical pants in dark gray or black with reinforced seams. Worn-in leather jacket in deep brown, scuffed at the cuffs from years of use, no corpo branding. Steel-toed work boots, black, maintained to functional standards rather than polish. No jewelry except a faded cloth wristband on left wrist (memorial or talisman—ambiguous origin). Clothing choices prioritize functionality and durability over style, with subtle tier-2 quality markers that suggest he has access to better than street level, but not corpo-grade luxury.

image_prompt: A 193cm tall South Asian and West African man with an intimidating jawline and shaved head, standing in a dimly lit industrial corridor, his cheekbones and temples glowing with faint blue-white bioluminescence from geneware implants. Warm medium-brown skin, dark eyes, unsmiling expression. Wearing a worn brown leather jacket over a black synthetic shirt and tactical pants, steel-toed boots. Hands at his sides showing subtle metallic ridges across his knuckles from subdermal impact plates. His posture is relaxed but controlled, careful and precise despite his enormous frame.
